objectives.en: Identify the users of financial statements.
Distinguish capital and revenue expenditure and receipts.

narration.en: A bank deciding on a loan, an investor buying shares and the GST officer all look at the same financial statements. Each wants different answers.

body.en: Internal users (owners, management) need information on profitability and control. External users have specific needs: lenders and creditors want to know if they will be repaid, investors look at profit and growth, the government needs data for taxes such as GST and income tax, and employees look at stability and bonus.

points.en: External: lenders, creditors, investors, government, employees

narration.kn: ಆಂತರಿಕ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರು (ಮಾಲೀಕರು, ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ) ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರು (ಸಾಲದಾತರು, ಹೂಡಿಕೆದಾರರು, ಸರ್ಕಾರ, ನೌಕರರು) ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

title.en: On the board: Capital or revenue?

say.en: Ask one question: how long does the benefit last? More than a year means capital; this year only means revenue.
A new machine and the wages to install it both give benefit for many years: capital expenditure.
Repairs to an old machine and salaries benefit only this year: revenue expenditure.
A big ad campaign whose benefit lasts three years is deferred revenue expenditure.
So the machine costs 2,10,000, and about one lakh of the campaign is written off each year.

body.en: Capital expenditure gives benefit for more than one year: buying fixed assets, and costs to bring them into use such as installation. Revenue expenditure benefits only the current year: salaries, rent, repairs. Deferred revenue expenditure is revenue in nature but its benefit spreads over a few years, such as heavy advertising. Capital receipts include capital introduced, loans and sale of fixed assets; revenue receipts include sales, commission and interest received.

points.en: Capital expenditure: benefit beyond one year
Revenue expenditure: benefit within the year
Deferred revenue: written off over a few years

narration.en: Capital expenditure gives benefit for more than one year: buying fixed assets, and costs to bring them into use such as installation. Revenue expenditure benefits only the current year: salaries, rent, repairs. Deferred revenue expenditure is revenue in nature but its benefit spreads over a few years, such as heavy advertising. Capital receipts include capital introduced, loans and sale of fixed assets; revenue receipts include sales, commission and interest received.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಲಾಭ ನೀಡುವ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ವೆಚ್ಚ; ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಲಾಭ ನೀಡುವುದು ಆದಾಯ ವೆಚ್ಚ. ಭಾರಿ ಜಾಹೀರಾತಿನಂತಹವು ಮುಂದೂಡಿದ ಆದಾಯ ವೆಚ್ಚ.

problem.en: Classify: (i) machinery purchased ₹2,00,000; (ii) wages for installing it ₹10,000; (iii) repairs to an old machine ₹5,000; (iv) salaries ₹60,000; (v) ad campaign ₹3,00,000 for a new product, benefit over 3 years.

steps.en: (i) and (ii): capital expenditure; the machine's cost becomes ₹2,10,000.
(iii) and (iv): revenue expenditure, charged to the current year.
(v) deferred revenue expenditure: about ₹1,00,000 written off each year for 3 years.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Classify: (i) machinery purchased ₹2,00,000; (ii) wages for installing it ₹10,000; (iii) repairs to an old machine ₹5,000; (iv) salaries ₹60,000; (v) ad campaign ₹3,00,000 for a new product, benefit over 3 years.

narration.en: CBSE board pattern: assertion–reason and case-based questions. Read the statements carefully before choosing.

points.en: Internal and external users need financial statements for different decisions.
points.kn: ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರಿಗೆ ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳು ಬೇಕು.

points.en: Capital expenditure benefits more than one year; revenue expenditure benefits the current year.
points.kn: ಬಂಡವಾಳ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷ ಲಾಭ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಆದಾಯ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ.

points.en: Costs of installing an asset are capital expenditure.

homework.en: Classify ten items of expenditure you see in a local shop as capital or revenue.

narration.en: Recap. Internal and external users need financial statements for different decisions. Capital expenditure benefits more than one year; revenue expenditure benefits the current year. Costs of installing an asset are capital expenditure.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರಿಗೆ ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳು ಬೇಕು. ಬಂಡವಾಳ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷ ಲಾಭ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಆದಾಯ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ. ಆಸ್ತಿಯ ಸ್ಥಾಪನಾ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ವೆಚ್ಚ.
